title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
key_facts: OpenAI is launching an 'Intelligent UI' feature in ChatGPT: answers can include diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons and interactive visuals.
The feature comes with GPT-6, which The Verge describes as OpenAI's newest model family; OpenAI says it trained GPT-6 on when to use visuals instead of text.
The article says OpenAI announced its first GPT-6 models last month; the Sol and Luna versions now reach ChatGPT.
Rollout: from 7 Oct 2026 to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users worldwide; Go and free tiers from Thursday (8 Oct).
Higher tiers get the mid-range GPT-6 Sol model; Go and free users get the more efficient GPT-6 Luna.
OpenAI also says GPT-6 searches the web better and gives quicker partial answers; the safety claim (stronger resistance to bypass attempts) is OpenAI's own.
quote_evidence: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals.
GPT-6 with Intelligent UI is rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users starting today, but will expand to Go and free tiers on Thursday.
why_it_matters_hint: Everyday ChatGPT users will see interactive visuals and small tools inside answers; quality and safety claims are OpenAI's own.
notes: Full article read (The Verge). Performance and safety claims are OpenAI's own statements.
